services.title: Window Installation & Replacement
services.shortDescription: Upgrade your home with energy-efficient windows in aluminium, uPVC, or timber.
services.fullDescription: New windows are one of the most impactful upgrades you can make to a property. They improve energy efficiency, boost security, reduce outside noise, and dramatically enhance kerb appeal. Fix and Glaze supplies and installs quality window frames in three primary materials.
services.idealFor: New builds, renovations, investment properties, energy upgrades, and heritage restorations
whatsIncluded: Supply and installation of frames and glass
Removal and disposal of existing windows

services.title: Glass Installation & Glazing
services.shortDescription: Professional glass panel installation for windows, doors, shower screens, and more.
services.fullDescription: Glass is at the heart of everything we do. Fix and Glaze installs glass panels in a wide variety of applications, using the right glass type for each job — from standard float glass to toughened safety glass, frosted glass, and more.
applications: Shower screens and enclosures (frameless, semi-frameless, framed)
Partition walls and office glass (commercial interiors)
services.idealFor: Residential renovations, commercial fit-outs, bathroom upgrades, office partitions

services.title: Door Installation & Fitting
services.shortDescription: Expert door installation for interior and exterior applications, residential and commercial.
services.fullDescription: A well-fitted door does more than just open and close — it contributes to your property's security, energy efficiency, acoustic performance, and visual appeal. Fix and Glaze installs interior and exterior doors across all frame types.
doorTypes: Commercial glass doors (frameless pivot, swing, automatic)
services.idealFor: Home renovations, new builds, commercial fit-outs, property upgrades

services.title: Glass Repair & Replacement
services.shortDescription: Fast, professional glass repair for windows, doors, and more. Emergency service available.
services.fullDescription: Cracked, chipped, or shattered glass is not just an eyesore — it's a safety and security risk. Fix and Glaze responds promptly to glass repair requests for both residential and commercial properties, replacing damaged panes quickly and cost-effectively.
commonRepairs: Broken glass panels in doors and frames
services.emergencyResponse: We understand that some glass damage can't wait. For urgent situations — break-ins, storm damage, or accidental breakage — contact us immediately. We'll work to get a technician to your property as quickly as possible.
services.idealFor: Emergency repairs, storm damage, accidental breakage, wear and tear

services.title: Commercial Glazing
services.shortDescription: Professional commercial glazing solutions for businesses of all sizes.
services.fullDescription: Fix and Glaze works with building managers, developers, retailers, and property investors to deliver professional commercial glazing solutions. We handle projects of all scales — from small retail fit-outs to large commercial buildings — with the same attention to detail.
services: Security glass and forced-entry resistant glazing
services.idealFor: Retail fit-outs, office interiors, building developers, property investors
